title: BreakCurl config
description: Reusable configuration for BreakCurl negative and security API checks. Reference it from your breakcurl.config.json with "$schema" for editor autocompletion.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema for editor autocompletion.

maxCases.description: Maximum number of checks for one run (hard limit: 200).

onlyPaths.description: Check only these JSON paths and their children.

excludePaths.description: Never mutate these JSON paths or their children.

expectAuth.description: With a complete authContract, require auth probes to return 401/403 (quick, security or full). Without it, 2xx remains a candidate. This is an HTTP contract, not proof of a completed operation.

authBodyPaths.description: Convenience selection of string JSON credential fields for partial auth probes. No array indices. Use authContract for a complete declaration; do not combine both options.

name.description: Human-readable check name shown in reports.

value.description: JSON value to set (required for operation=set).

expect.description: Oracle applied to the API response.

authContract.description: Operator declaration that these are all auth sources; credentials in paths, transport, server-side sessions and undeclared locations are absent. Values remain in the source cURL, never in this declaration.

pointer.description: Non-root RFC 6901 pointer to a non-empty string object property. Arrays and prototype traversal are unsupported.

jsonPath.description: JSON path starting with $, e.g. $.email or $.profile.status.
